result.topic_en: Latin draft passage arguing that the usual definition of a function of a complex variable contains superfluous conditions, since values of the function on a very small region already determine its values elsewhere.
result.transcription:
vis valore determinato [-fun-] argumenti
valor detur functionis. Nos autem demon-
stravimus, si in amplitudine admodum
exigua pro valoribus argumenti valor[-es sit-] sint
dat{+i+}[-ae-] functionis, ex his valores functio-
nis pro [-la-] reliquis valoribus jam sequi;
eamque assignavimus amplitudinem con-
ditionum a se independentium, quae ad
determinandam functionem necessaria
sit. In vulgari igitur functionis [-deter-
minatae-] definitione notae superfluae
inesse nobis videntur.

methods.what: Identity/uniqueness principle: values of a complex function on an arbitrarily small region determine its values everywhere else
methods.quote:

nis pro [-la-] reliquis valoribus jam sequi

methods.quote:

items.english: But we have demonstrated that if, in a very small region, values of the function are given for the values of the argument, then from these the values of the function for the remaining values already follow

items.quote:
In vulgari igitur functionis [-deter-
minatae-] definitione notae superfluae
inesse nobis videntur.
items.english: Therefore, the common definition of a function seems to us to contain superfluous characteristics.
